This '''bounty hunter''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] who lived around the [[Time/Legends|time]] following the [[New Sith Wars]]. In [[987 BBY]], the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] tracked [[Salto Zendar]] to a [[Medcenter/Legends|hospital]] on [[Bandomeer/Legends|Bandomeer]] in an attempt to win the substantial [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] which had been set forth by the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]]. The Twi'lek arrived in the hospital and found Zendar shortly after another hunter, [[Lucia (soldier)|Lucia]]. He quickly shot Lucia in the stomach with his [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] and knocked aside the [[Nurse/Legends|nurse]] in the room, [[Serra]], to get to Zendar. He dragged the fugitive out to a hallway, however, several other bounty hunters joined the attack. By the end of [[Skirmish in the Bandomeer hospital|the skirmish]], Zendar was dead, along with four of the attacking bounty hunters and several civilians.
